Scene 02

Scene 02

Dana Scully

We live in a darkness of our own making... Blind to a habitant world all but unseen by us. A world of beings traveling through time and space imaginable to us only as flights of fancy. Who are these beings we dare to imagine but fear to accept? What dark work goes on inside their impossible machines... Cloaked from us by invisible forces? If they know our secrets, why can't we know theirs?

Scene 03

Scene 03

Gibson Praise

Stop it, please.

Unidentified speaker

No.

Gibson Praise

Stop it. Let me go. Let me go.

John Doggett

Let the boy go! Let him go, Mulder! Let him go, or I will be compelled to use my weapon. Now, I don't want to do that, agent Mulder. I don't want to shoot. Now, are you armed? Come on, damn it. This is just stupid, agent Mulder. Don't turn this into a movie. Just tell me if you've got a gun. It's too hot for this b.s. All right, then, lie down. Lie down on the ground. Keep your hands out. Lay down on your belly there. For crying out loud, what are you doing? Agent Mulder, stay there! He went over! Over the edge!

Agent Crane

Who?

John Doggett

Mulder.

Female Agent

I have no explanation...

John Doggett

Right, I'll talk to Scully. You guys head back to the school.

Dana Scully

Where is he? Where's Mulder?

John Doggett

I don't know.

Dana Scully

You don't know? I heard an agent say over the radio that you saw him.

John Doggett

Oh, yeah, I saw him. I saw him back right off that cliff there and I saw him fall right over there.

Walter Skinner

Then where is he?

John Doggett

He's gone.

Walter Skinner

Come on. He can't be gone.

John Doggett

Yeah, he can't be, but he is.

Walter Skinner

That cliff there? He fell from there? It's impossible... A fall like that.

John Doggett

A cop sees things. A man drops five stories, dusts his head off and goes back to work. An old lady gets shot point-blank in a chinese restaurant plucks the slug out of her egg foo young. But even if Mulder survives this what he does then is too much. You got your point of impact there where agent Scully is standing... Clear and identifiable. And a set of tracks here leading down to the wash. Look at these tracks. What do you see? Mulder was running.

Dana Scully

It wasn't Mulder.

John Doggett

That's the one thing I'm sure of.

Dana Scully

It may have looked like Mulder, but it wasn't Mulder.

John Doggett

I told you I knew Mulder. Okay, maybe I didn't know him that well. But I know who it was up there, and it was Fox Mulder.

Dana Scully

I'm sure it did look like Mulder and you have every reason to believe that it was him... But it was not Mulder. I told you that I've seen things... Things that I can't explain. Well, I have seen what looks like a man transform into another man.

John Doggett

What looks like a man, but who's not a man?

[ sighs ]

John Doggett

So, what is he?

Dana Scully

You don't want to know.

John Doggett

He's not a man? What the hell is he? Hey, don't turn your back on me. I'm asking you a legitimate question.

Dana Scully

He's alien. He's a bounty hunter.

John Doggett

Looking to collect a bounty on...?

Dana Scully

On Gibson Praise... Because he's part alien. He's a human anomaly.

John Doggett

So, this alien bounty hunter... He disguised himself as Mulder to come out here and grab the boy?

Dana Scully

To take him back to his ship... Where we believe Mulder is.

John Doggett

You know, agent Scully... You're, uh, you're starting to remind me a lot of agent Mulder yourself.

Dana Scully

Well, then, you explain it to me.

Walter Skinner

If it's true or possible, what you're saying-- that there's someone like this out there this bounty hunter-- he could just become anyone. You, me, any damn one of us.

Dana Scully

I think that it is true. And possible. Wherever Mulder is right now... He better damn well be smiling.

Scene 04

Secretary

Is this authorized?

Agent Mosley

Right. They're here.

John Doggett

Any sign of him? Mulder?

Agent Crane

Not according to these people. We went through the school.

John Doggett

You're better than this.

Agent Crane

Sir?

John Doggett

He's got to be here somewhere. Let's search the school again.

[ door creaks ]

[ bones crunch ]

[ footsteps approaching ]

John Doggett

Hello? Sorry, I thought you were... I thought they cleared you out of here.

Agent Crane

Find something?

John Doggett

No. Let's keep looking.

Voice On Radio

Administration building is clear.

Agent Mosley

Copy, check it again.

Walter Skinner

What I want to know is how Doggett got out here. How did he even know where we were going?

Dana Scully

I don't know. But he's going to turn this place upside down looking for the wrong person.

Walter Skinner

What happened to Gibson Praise?

Dana Scully

Well, whatever happened to him, he's long gone. Wherever he is, he's three steps ahead of us.

Walter Skinner

Don't look now but we've got a pair of eyeballs on us. Just start walking, I'll be right behind you. Can I talk to you for a minute?

Gibson Praise

You shouldn't have come here. You shouldn't have come. You'll lead them to me.

Dana Scully

I'm here to protect you, Gibson.

[ sighs deeply ]

Dana Scully

I know you know that's the truth. I know you know my thoughts.

Gibson Praise

I know they took the man you work with, Mulder. And now, they've come to take me.

Dana Scully

The only reason they want to take you, Gibson is because you're a special boy. They want to take you because of what you are.

Thea

I'm sorry. I didn't know that someone was following me.

Gibson Praise

My friend thea knows. She's the only one at school I've told. She says the FBI is looking for me, too. She's afraid for me.

Dana Scully

She has a right to be afraid. We don't know who to trust now.

Gibson Praise

I fell when I was running away.

Dana Scully

I think you might have broken it, Gibson.

Gibson Praise

If they find me, they'll take me. I know it. I've always known it.

Dana Scully

I'm going to make you a splint, Gibson, okay? I can set your leg, but, uh... I'm going to need a car to get you out of here.

[ breathes heavily ]

Dana Scully

I'm going to come back for you. I promise. I'm not going to let anything bad happen to you.

Gibson Praise

You said that to me once before.

[ car engines starting ]

[ phone rings ]

Scene 05

Agent Mosley

Yeah? Deputy director for you.

John Doggett

Yeah, this is john Doggett.

Alvin Kersh

Agent Doggett, I'm getting reports from arizona...

Alvin Kersh

...that you found agent Mulder.

I'm afraid somebody jumped the gun on that. I saw him, sir, but I...

Alvin Kersh

What do you mean, you saw him? What the hell is going on out there?

John Doggett

Well, we're 'round the clock here. I've got local s.a.r., a rolling ground cordon and an eye in the sky. We're on top of the situation.

Alvin Kersh

How does the FBI find a man and then lose him in the middle of the desert? 'cause I'd like to know. Agent Doggett, are you there?

John Doggett

Yeah. I heard the question.

Alvin Kersh

I put you in charge out there, Doggett. Now do the damn job.

[ clicks phone off ]

John Doggett

This amuse you? I amuse you?

Walter Skinner

No. It just made sense to me. How you found your way out here. Who led you to Gibson Praise.

John Doggett

You think I was spying on you?

Walter Skinner

No, but I think our new deputy director was. You're being made a pawn in a rigged game.

[ sighs ]

John Doggett

All right, you've painted me the picture, now put it in a frame.

Walter Skinner

All right. You've got a good rep, agent Doggett. You don't compromise, you don't quit. You're a damned good FBI agent-- best of the best. Lot of guys put you in the director's chair one day. Which is why you've been set up to fail. There's no amount of search and rescue or rolling cordons or eyes in the sky that are going to turn up Mulder. It's just the wrong approach.

John Doggett

It's not a question of approach. It's the only approach I got.

Walter Skinner

The only way you're going to find Mulder is to give into the truth. To listen to Scully. But even then... Say you did find him. Even then you lose. You put anything about aliens or UFO's or alien bounty hunters in your report... Kersh will ruin you. I'm betting that was his plan.

John Doggett

Is agent Scully here? Where's agent Scully?

Agent Mosley

I need someone who's with agent Scully to put her on a radio. Someone... With agent Scully. Anyone got a twenty on agent Scully? Is anyone out there with her?

Agent Landau

I'm with agent Scully.

Agent Mosley

Then who's this?

Agent Landau

Go for agent Scully.

Dana Scully

What?

John Doggett

Give me the radio. You're with Scully?

Agent Landau

Right across the room from her.

Dana Scully

From who? From me? Where?

John Doggett

What room? Where are you?

Agent Landau

Bunkhouse. We're in the dorm.

Dana Scully

Tell him to hold her. Tell him not to let her out of his sight!

John Doggett

Hold Scully. We're coming to you.

Agent Landau

Agent Scully--

[ choking ]

[ choking ]

[ groaning ]

Dana Scully

Hey!! There she is. Do you see her? Where did she go? Did you see her?

Agent Crane

No.

Dana Scully

She ran right back here. I saw her. You saw her.

[ gasping for breath ]

Dana Scully

Agent... Can you breathe?

[ panicked breaths ]

Dana Scully

He thinks it was me. He thinks that I did this to him. How is that possible? It's someone in this room.

[ breathing heavily ]

Scene 07

Walter Skinner

Agent Scully. Where are you going? Agent Scully. Get out of the car. Agent Scully!

Dana Scully

Who are you?

Walter Skinner

Who am I?

Dana Scully

Drop your weapon and turn around.

Walter Skinner

I'm not going to turn around.

Dana Scully

Just do it! I know how it works-- kill shot to the back of the neck.

Walter Skinner

Scully, you're pointing your weapon at a friend.

Dana Scully

Turn around, or I'm going to assume that you're not who you say you are.

Walter Skinner

Scully, it's me! Skinner! I can prove it. I know your secret-- who else knows it?

Dana Scully

Okay... Then tell me.

Walter Skinner

You tell me. How do I know it's you?

[ panting ]

Walter Skinner

I don't like pointing guns at pregnant women any more than I like them pointing guns at me. This has gone too far, Scully.

Dana Scully

No. That's what's wrong here. It hasn't gone far enough. I need those car keys.

Walter Skinner

And what do you think you're going to do?

Dana Scully

Look, we are being hampered here by the FBI, by john Doggett by doubt, by our own mistrust. Whatever it is, it is working as long as we let it.

Walter Skinner

You told me Mulder wouldn't allow it. Wouldn't let me ruin my career over this. Over him. But what about you, Scully? I mean, my god, you've got even more at stake.

Dana Scully

I-I can't take the chance that I'm never going to see him again.

Walter Skinner

Mulder could just come walking out of the dark-- we don't know.

Dana Scully

Look... We've got one last chance here waiting for us out there in the desert-- Gibson Praise. It may just be who gets to him first.

Walter Skinner

Get in the car. I'll drive.

Dana Scully

Gibson!

Walter Skinner

He's not down there.

Dana Scully

I told him to stay here. He was supposed to stay here. Gibson! I found him. Gibson. What are you doing out here? Why didn't you answer me, huh?

Gibson Praise

He's here. I hear him.

Dana Scully

What are you talking about?

Gibson Praise

Mulder. He's somewhere out there.

Dana Scully

He's got a really bad fever. I think his leg might be infected.

Walter Skinner

All right, we got to get you to the hospital, okay, buddy?

Gibson Praise

You're so close now.

Walter Skinner

I'll carry you. Put your arm around my neck. Watch your legs. Agent Scully.

Dana Scully

You take him to the hospital.

Walter Skinner

What about you?

Hey, you're where the action is.

Dana Scully

What does that tell you? That I'm crazy, or that I'm right?

John Doggett

Wandering around in the desert in the dead of night, you call it.

You've seen this crap for yourself now. How do you explain what took place today?

You knew where the kid was and you wouldn't tell me. Why?

Dana Scully

Your men... Followed assistant director Skinner?

John Doggett

Hey, where you going? Agent Scully, where you going?

Dana Scully

John Doggett

Fox Mulder

Scully! Scully!
